title: Study of Effectiveness of Lovastatin to Prevent Radiation-Induced Rectal Injury

sections.abstract:
Lovastatin may protect against late effects of radiation therapy in patients with prostate cancer

Posted outcomes: Percentage of Participants With Physician Reported Rectal Toxicity ≥ Grade 2 During the First 2 Years of Radiation Treatment. timeframe=24 months. Supportive Care (Lovastatin) (Evaluable)=38. p=0.9138
